profiles.name: Lashworm
notes: The PDF visually confirms Initiative 100 and the printed Small Size. Immobile while attacking from its burrow. Always strikes first. The attack triggers within 5 yards, with a Difficult (−10) Cool Test for Surprise. It feeds after a successful wound and rests for four hours.

profiles.name: Monstrous Leech
notes: Printed Little is Fourth Edition. Review conversion and retain printed Wounds 2 if converted to Tiny. On land Movement 1 and −2 SL to Tests. Relies on vibration, not sight. After a wound it attaches and applies Bleeding 1 until killed, repelled or a round’s d10 rolls 9–10. Pulling it off inflicts Bleeding 1. Fire, salt or acid can repel it. Aquatic and Blood Drain need source-specific review.
Printed Wounds apply to the baseline. Core Tiny Size requires manual Wounds after changes.

profiles.name: Unseen Ghost

Printed entry for manual review: Fear 2 (after seeing thrown object).
